full_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: structural sketch for a tiny medieval pixel RPG environment prop, one candidate only. Make one short solid weathered wooden mooring post that marks the return to shore. Single object on true transparency, upright, near-orthographic slightly elevated front view. Clearly flattened oval cut top, cylindrical volume with dark right side, a broad pale horizontal WHITE BAND across the upper middle, then a separate single tan rope wrap below it with a clearly protruding knot at front-left and a short hanging rope end separated from the trunk by negative space. Lower third has a restrained dark desaturated green-brown tide/water stain. The white band is a navigation landmark, no arrows or writing needed. Design explicitly for eventual 32 by 48 pixel research canvas: large intentional discrete flat color clusters, roughly 18 pixel trunk width and 39 pixel visible height; very few short organized woodgrain marks, no dense grain or barnacles, no noise, no dither, no long vertical glossy highlight, no photoreal texture. Left-upper light, dark brown outlines, warm weathered brown wood, oatmeal rope and band. Preserve round solid timber volume rather than a flat plastic column. Near-horizontal ellipse with only small visible top surface; no deep perspective. No load-level notches, no metal straps, no heraldry, no letters, no ground, dock, water, boat, road, people, extra objects, cast shadow, infographic, multiple views or labels. Entire post and rope within frame. This is a new structural redraw concept, not a direct resized detailed illustration.
